title: CRLR/33/2019 of G. B. ENTERPRISES (JASPUR) Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
CRLR No. 33 of 2019
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Mohd. Umar, Advocate for the
revisionist.
Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, Brief Holder for
the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Devang Dobhal, Advocate on
behalf of Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate for
the private respondents.
This Revision is emanating from the
judgment impugned dated 19th February,
2015, as rendered passed by the Special
Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham
Singh Nagar in Complaint Case No. 6 of
2013, Alok Kumar Agarwal Vs. G.B.
Enterprises and another, whereby, in the
proceedings of trial held under Section 138 of
the Negotiable Instruments Act, the
revisionist has been sentenced to undergo two
months imprisonment and a fine of
Rs.1,50,000/- was imposed upon him and in
the event of default of payment of fine, he has
been further directed to serve three months of
rigorous imprisonment. The said judgment of
the Special Judicial Magistrate has been
affirmed by the judgment dated 5th January,
2019, by the Court of 1st Additional Session
Judge, Udham Singh Nagar in Criminal
Appeal No. 46 of 2015, G.B. Enterprises &
another Vs. Alok Kumar and another,
whereby, the appeal has been dismissed,
consequently affirming conviction.
On 17.01.2019, the Registry has
reported that there was a defect in the
Criminal Revision as the detention certificate
was not supplied alongwith the Revision,
when it was filed, which is to be annexed
compulsorily.
The Revision was taken upon on 18th
January, 2019. The Counsel for the

revisionist was granted time to remove the
defects. Thereafter, twice the time was taken
by the revisionist to remove the defect, i.e. on
29.01.2019 and 27.02.2019 and it is almost
now a year has lapsed where the defect has
not been removed.
In such an eventuality, since the defect
as pointed out by the Registry has not been
removed, this Court declines to entertain the
Revision.
Consequently, the Criminal Revision is
dismissed.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 09.01.2020
Shiv
